text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, acyclovir sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale General holds 211 tablets of the 400 mg presentation at 15.5 per day, giving 13.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 339 vials of the 500 mg/10 mL injection at 15.4 per day, giving 22 days on hand. Corvale East holds 502 vials of the 500 mg/10 mL injection at 13 per day, giving 38.5 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 101 vials of the 500 mg/10 mL injection at 4.1 per day, giving 24.8 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows acyclovir sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 13.6 to 38.5 days across sites. The lowest coverage is the 400 mg tablets at Corvale General. The rule ranks Eugia US LLC as the first alternate manufacturer; it is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place. We must verify whether Eugia US LLC supply can be traced to a registered plant and review OAI inspections at Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) on 2024-02-02 and 2026-02-06 and the 2024-08-15 Warning Letter.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify Eugia US LLC supply chain traceability to a registered plant and review cited OAI inspections and Warning Letter; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as second alternate; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as third alternate; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Slate Run Pharmaceuticals, LLC as fourth alternate; requires P&T Committee approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate Zydus Lifesciences Limited as fifth alternate; requires P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
